task.title: Creating a registry-wide auto-pruning policy
task.shortdesc: To apply an auto-prune policy to all organizations in a Red Hat Quay registry, you can configure DEFAULT_NAMESPACE_AUTOPRUNE_POLICY in your config.yaml file.

ul.li: You have enabled the FEATURE_AUTO_PRUNE feature.

context.p: Registry-wide auto-pruning policies can apply to new and existing organizations. Red Hat Quay administrators enable this feature by adding the DEFAULT_NAMESPACE_AUTOPRUNE_POLICY configuration field with either the number_of_tags or creation_date method. Currently, you cannot enable this feature by using the v2 UI or the API.
